    Engine
    The engine: it owns the configuration, the scenes, and the callback loop, and it drives module initialization.
    KnotCurvedSpacetime
    The launcher for the Quilt variant.
    Main
    The launcher for both closed-world variants.
    MainCallback
    Work the engine runs once at start-up and then repeatedly, independent of any scene.
    MainModuleConfig
    The engine's own settings, read from config/curved-spacetime-main-module.config.
    MainModuleEngineImpl
    Engine Implementation
    ModuleConfig
    A module's persisted settings, backed by a java.util.Properties file under config/.
    ModuleDependentModuleInitializer<E>
    The callback by which one module learns of another module it depends on.
    ModuleInitializer
    A module's main entrypoint, the object the engine drives during initialization.

    Keyboard input backed by GLFW.
    RenderGLFWModuleKeyboardInput.KeyCtx
    A key identified the way GLFW reports it.
    RenderGLFWModuleMouseInput
    Mouse input backed by GLFW.
    RenderGLFWModuleRenderer
    Base for renderers that draw a scene into a GLFW window.
    RenderGLFWModuleWindow
    A window backed by GLFW, sized to the primary monitor.
    RenderModuleKeyboardInput
    Keyboard state for one window, independent of the windowing library providing it.
    RenderModuleKeyboardInput.KeyCallback
    A listener notified when a key changes state.
    RenderModuleKeyboardInput.KeyCtx
    Identifies a key.
    RenderModuleMouseInput
    Mouse state for one window, independent of the windowing library providing it.
    RenderModuleWindow
    A window, and the keyboard and mouse attached to it, independent of the windowing library.

    Draws a scene into a GLFW window using Vulkan.
    RenderVulkanGLFWModuleRenderModuleSurface
    A Vulkan surface created from a GLFW window.
    RenderVulkanGLFWModuleWindow
    A GLFW window configured for Vulkan rather than OpenGL.
    RenderVulkanModuleForwardRenderActivity
    Forward rendering into the swap chain: a render pass, and the per-image resources that feed it.
    RenderVulkanModuleFrameBuffer
    A framebuffer: the concrete set of image views a render pass draws into.
    RenderVulkanModuleGraphicsQueue
    A queue selected for graphics work.
    RenderVulkanModuleGraphicsQueue.RenderVulkanPresentModuleGraphicsQueue
    A queue selected for presenting to a particular surface.
    RenderVulkanModuleImageView
    A view onto a Vulkan image, describing how that image is to be interpreted.
    RenderVulkanModuleImageView.VulkanImageViewData
    How an image should be interpreted by a view, built up fluently.
    RenderVulkanModuleSurface
    A Vulkan surface: the bridge between a platform window and Vulkan's presentation machinery.
    RenderVulkanModuleSurface.SurfaceFormat
    A pixel format paired with the colour space it is interpreted in.
    RenderVulkanModuleSwapChain
    The swap chain: the queue of images the GPU renders into and the surface presents.
    RenderVulkanModuleSwapChain.SynchronizationVulkanSemaphores
    The pair of semaphores that order one frame's work.
    RenderVulkanModuleSwapChain.VulkanSurfaceFormat
    A pixel format paired with the colour space it is interpreted in.
    RenderVulkanModuleSwapChainRenderPass
    A single-subpass render pass that draws straight into the swap chain.
    Scene
    One independent thing being simulated and drawn.
    SceneCallback
    Work the engine runs once at start-up and then repeatedly, against one particular scene.
    Start
    The common entry point every variant of Curved Spacetime starts through.
    VulkanModuleCommandBuffer
    A Vulkan command buffer allocated from a VulkanModuleCommandPool.
    VulkanModuleCommandPool
    A Vulkan command pool, from which command buffers for one queue family are allocated.
    VulkanModuleFence
    A Vulkan fence, used by the host to wait for work submitted to a queue to finish.
    VulkanModuleLogicalDevice
    A Vulkan logical device: the application's connection to a selected physical device.
    VulkanModulePhysicalDevice
    A Vulkan physical device — a GPU the driver has reported — together with everything queried about it.
    VulkanModuleQueue
    A Vulkan queue, the channel through which recorded work reaches the device.
    VulkanModuleSemaphore
    A Vulkan semaphore, used to order work between queue submissions on the device.
    VulkanModuleVulkan
    Owns the Vulkan objects that outlive any one window: the instance, the physical device, and the logical device.
    VulkanModuleVulkanInstance
    The Vulkan instance: the application's connection to the Vulkan loader, and the object every physical device is enumerated from.
    VulkanUtils
    Helpers shared across the Vulkan modules.
    VulkanUtils.OSType
    The host operating systems distinguished by VulkanUtils.getOS().
